citation.authors: Hashizume M, Kinami S, Sakurai K, Izawa KP, Shiotani H
citation.title: Postprandial Blood Pressure Decrease in Patients with Type 2 Diabetes and Mild or Severe Cardiac Autonomic Dysfunction
citation.journal: Int J Environ Res Public Health

population.description: Control group of 17 adults without type 2 diabetes (13 M, 4 F; 20 were recruited, Figure 2 and Results give 17 analysed), recruited by advertisement at Kobe University; inclusion age 40 to 80 y; exclusions pre-existing diabetes, cardiovascular or arrhythmic disease, pregnancy, night-shift work, smoking (Methods 2.1). No OGTT or HbA1c was done and the paper cannot exclude impaired glucose tolerance (Discussion), so the group is unselected, not healthy. Age 54.8 +/- 1.58 y and BMI 22.0 +/- 0.47 kg/m2 are mean +/- SE (Table 1); sd computed here as SE x sqrt(17) = 6.51 y and 1.94 kg/m2. Min and max not printed.

protocols.name: control_pre_meal
protocols.description: Control group, seated rest from 11:30 (Methods 2.2: 'Assessments began at 11:30. After 10 min of rest in a seated position, blood pressure ... measured'); the seated BP, the supine ECG and the blood draw all came before the test meal, started at 12:00 (minute 30). The arm stops at minute 29 because no finding uses the meal. Fed state unknown: the participants were asked to finish breakfast by 7:30, its contents are not printed and no fast is stated, so no meal is entered and the start is typical values (norm_center). Duration 30 min = 11:30 to 12:00 (derived from the printed clock times).

findings.description: Brachial systolic BP of the control group before the test meal, seated after the 10-min rest (mean of the two readings per person, mean +/- SE, n = 17); window minutes 10 to 30 of the arm, the seated measurements before the meal at 12:00.

location.where: Table 1, row 'bSBP (mmHg)', column Control (n = 17); footnote 'Data given as mean ± SE.'

findings.description: Brachial diastolic BP of the control group before the test meal, seated after the 10-min rest (mean +/- SE, n = 17); window minutes 10 to 30 of the arm.

location.where: Table 1, row 'bDBP (mmHg)', column Control (n = 17); footnote 'Data given as mean ± SE.'

findings.description: Heart rate of the control group before the test meal, from the 200-pulse ECG taken in the supine position after the seated BP and before the blood draw (mean +/- SE, n = 17); window minutes 10 to 30 of the arm.

location.where: Table 1, row 'HR (bpm)', column Control (n = 17); footnote 'Data given as mean ± SE.'

left_out.what: Control group postprandial bSBP, cSBP and HR at 60 and 120 min after the test meal (Figure 4; the text gives only the direction of change)
Control group glucose and insulin over the meal (Figure 3, control curves; figure only)
Control plasma glucose before the meal (Table 1) and at 120 min after the meal (Discussion): breakfast contents not printed, so the fed state cannot be written
Control serum insulin before the meal (Table 1): breakfast contents not printed, so the fed state cannot be written
Control central systolic BP before the meal (Table 1, cSBP): the model's sbp is brachial, and central pressure is a different measurement
Control CVRR (coefficient of variation of R-R intervals) before the meal (Table 1): an R-R variability index the model does not carry (its hrv is RMSSD)
Mild (n = 20) and severe (n = 15) T2DM groups: brachial and central SBP before, at 60 and 120 min after the test meal (Results, paragraph 2, with +/- SE values)

Mild and severe T2DM groups: all Table 1 columns (BMI, BP, HR, glucose, insulin, lipids, CVRR), Table 2 (diabetes duration, HbA1c, medication), and their postprandial glucose, insulin and HR (Figures 3 and 4, Results)
Pearson correlations of the blood pressure changes with baseline BP and CVRR, across all 52 participants including the T2DM groups (Results, Pearson's paragraph)
